t: A Boer republic between the Orange and Vaal rivers, recognised by Britain in the Bloemfontein Convention of 1854.
Its orderly constitution and long presidency of Johannes Brand earned it the name of a model republic.
Wars with the Basotho won it fertile land, but its alliance with the Transvaal led to its conquest in the Second Boer War.
dyk: After Britain took the diamond fields of Griqualand West in 1871, the Free State settled the quarrel peacefully: President Brand accepted £90,000 in compensation in 1876.
ev: Britain defeats Boers under Andries Pretorius at Boomplaats and rules the Orange River Sovereignty
The Bloemfontein Convention recognises the independence of the Orange Free State
Moshoeshoe cedes land west of the Caledon River in the Treaty of Thaba Bosiu
Britain annexes the diamond fields of Griqualand West
Defensive alliance with the South African Republic
Bloemfontein falls to Lord Roberts and Britain annexes the state as the Orange River Colony
The Treaty of Vereeniging ends the Second Boer War and the republic
